unproven: The only forward money test (the PC paper, 0.93 days) made $12.93 of rewards and lost $13.54 on 3 fills: net -$0.61.
Kalshi publishes no order-book history, so every backtest reward assumes today's depth; if other bidders crowd the thin 1c levels the reward shrinks fast.
The red team found the same kind of rule lost $3.06 a day per $100 in the first 43 hours after the replay window, and that most small orders fall under Kalshi's $1 minimum per market.
Only 3 of about 40 series-and-price cells passed, which chance alone can produce; the 1c bids were watched forward for only half an hour.
Real payouts were never checked against a real account, and the program ends January 1, 2027 (Kalshi can change it any day).
